description: Bounded deterministic float64 scan of a scalar <= or >= claim over a declared grid of 1–6 variables. Reports numerical witnesses, undefined and uncertain evaluations, and the exact stop reason. A propagated screening guard rejects near-boundary candidates; it is not a certified interval or formal proof. An inconclusive outcome preserves unresolved sampled cells; absence of a witness does not establish the claim over the continuous box.
name: scan_counterexample
title: Scan a grid for a counterexample
